beats.line: and while you slept the rats would continue to gorge on your flesh
when you finally woke up you would discover hundreds of bites throughout your entire body
and depending on your crime you were left here for days or weeks on end
Towards the end of the medieval period the developers of this punishment got lazy
and it simply became a permanent execution zone where prisoners were thrown in
and completely forgotten about. Number one:
Eagle's Nest Cave. Eagle's Nest Cave
in Florida is the second deadliest cave on the planet
having claimed the lives of at least thirteen experienced divers in recent years
but from the outside looking in it actually appears to be a decent beautiful swimming hole
